mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP (more than 1% quarter-over-quarter) indicates a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 dropped by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (more than 2% month-over-month) indicates supply chain disruptions, which typically lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO dropped by more than 2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real GDP (above $18 trillion) indicates strong economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 is above $18 trillion.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising CPI (more than 0.3% month-over-month) and stable or decreasing federal funds rate suggests inflationary pressure without monetary tightening, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% MoM and FEDFUNDS stable or decrease
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% MoM and FEDFUNDS was stable or decreased.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of a low unemployment rate (below 4%) and increasing nonfarm payrolls (more than 200,000) suggests a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE was below 4% and PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a significant increase in housing starts (more than 5% month-over-month) during an economic expansion signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% MoM during an economic expansion.
